checks.exercise: Distinct squeeze-press path inspected in full and side preview sheets
checks.equipment: Two dumbbells and flat bench with head support
checks.setup: 평벤치에 등과 머리를 받치고 양발을 바닥에 둔 채 덤벨을 잡는다.
checks.hands: Neutral close grip with constant dumbbell spacing
checks.feet: Both feet, head and trunk fixed
checks.movement: 손바닥이 서로 마주 보게 잡고 덤벨을 모은 채 가슴 위로 밀어 올렸다가 내린다.

limitations: Slow procedural demonstration; not captured human movement or full collision certification.
Small elbow bend retained at top; the bottom deliberately stops above the chest.
Squeeze dumbbells maintain a small geometric gap rather than simulating compression force. Sampled plate/body/pad and inter-dumbbell clearances are recorded.
